rationale: OMIM entry *601796 explicitly records that the two unrelated patients with autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder-73 (MRD73; OMIM #620450) were identified by Bertoli-Avella et al. (2021). Furthermore, Bertoli-Avella et al. (2021) identified de novo loss-of-function variants in TAF4 leading to neurodevelopmental delay and intellectual disability, establishing causality and early diagnostic panel curation prior to larger phenotypic cohort descriptions.
